tasks.question: Translate into English: 'I work every day'.
Insert the correct form: She (go) to school yesterday.
Put the verb in the correct tense: He (read) a book now.
Choose the modal verb: You (must/can) drive a car if you have a license.
Translate: If I had time, I would go to the cinema.
tasks.answer: If I had time, I would go to the cinema.

tasks.question: Change into passive voice: They built this house in 1990.
Change into reported speech: He said, 'I am happy'.
tasks.answer: He said that he was happy.

tasks.question: Write the past simple forms: go, see, eat.
Translate: She usually gets up at 7 am.
tasks.answer: She usually gets up at 7 am.

tasks.question: Which word is the odd one out: always, yesterday, usually, sometimes?
tasks.answer: yesterday (it is a Past Simple marker, the others are Present Simple markers)
